mechanics.claim: The Ball deals magic damage to enemies it passes through while flying to the target, and shields the target upon arrival.
mechanics.quote: dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies it passes through and granting the target a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds upon arrival

mechanics.claim: The bonus resistances are granted to whichever unit The Ball is attached to, even without a fresh cast.
mechanics.quote: Orianna gains ''Command: Protect's'' bonus resistances whenever ''The Ball'' is attached to her (even if she didn't self-cast).

mechanics.claim: Orianna cannot cast her other abilities while The Ball is in flight to the target.
mechanics.quote: '''Orianna''' cannot cast her other abilities while the ''The Ball'' is moving to the target with ''Command: Protect''.
